title: Chrome DevTools update adds more tools for AI coding agents
summary: Chrome's November 2026 DevTools update, covering Chrome 155 and 156, expands DevTools for agents with CSS style inspection, configuration file support and chunked trace parsing, and adds a visual position-area editor for CSS anchors.
body: The Chrome for Developers blog published its "New in DevTools" round-up for November 2026 on October 20, covering Chrome 155 and 156.
DevTools for agents, the MCP server that lets coding agents drive DevTools, gains CSS style inspection, configuration file support, and chunked trace parsing for large performance traces.
For people using DevTools directly, the Elements panel gets a visual editor for the CSS anchor `position-area` property, and the Application panel adds diagnostics for Web Install manifests.
why: If you use an AI coding assistant on front-end work, it can now inspect computed styles and read long performance traces through DevTools instead of guessing from source code.
Anchor positioning is becoming practical for tooltips and menus without JavaScript, and the new editor makes the `position-area` grid easier to reason about.
